subject: Web Development
title: User-Generated Content Takes Over
description: A quick win: understand User-Generated Content Takes Over.

hook.text: Wikipedia launched in 2001 with zero articles. Volunteers wrote everything.

buildup.text: YouTube followed in 2005, letting anyone upload video without technical knowledge.

discovery.text: The web's content was no longer made by professionals. Users became the creators.

twist.text: Platforms profited enormously from free labor. Creators rarely saw the revenue.

climax.text: User-generated content became the foundation of the entire internet economy.

punchline.text: Users built the web companies monetized.

quiz.question: What did Wikipedia launch with in 2001?
